themes.description: Covers feedback related to the availability, functionality, and performance of trading-specific tools and features like options, charts, and order types.
Feedback related to the overall usability, design, interface, and information presentation within the application.
Covers general user satisfaction, app design, ease of use, feature requests, and overall positive or negative feedback related to the application's interface and functionality.
General positive comments, satisfaction, or praise for the service without specific details.
Suggestions for new functionalities, improvements to existing features, or requests for additional tools within the application.
Concerns related to the app appearing unsolicited, advertising, or issues with app store visibility and discovery.
This theme covers issues related to the application's user interface, design choices, default settings, and overall user experience that lead to confusion or unintended actions.

This theme covers issues related to missing or incomplete features, data display inaccuracies, or limitations in the application's core functionalities, such as portfolio views or fund management options.
Issues related to account creation, activation, or the onboarding process, including status-related blocks.
Reviews related to the availability, success rate, or features concerning investment products like IPOs, mutual funds, or other market instruments.
Reviews expressing overall satisfaction or positive sentiment about the app or service, without focusing on a specific feature or issue.
Reviews praising the simplicity, intuitiveness, or user-friendliness of the application's design and functionality.
Covers feedback related to the ease of use, intuitiveness, and overall user-friendliness of the application interface.
Feedback related to changes, issues, or preferences regarding new application updates and their impact on features or user experience.
Feedback related to the application's ease of use, user interface design, navigation, and overall user-friendliness.
Concerns related to alleged manipulation of trades, unfair practices, or issues impacting the fairness and integrity of trading activities.
Issues related to account creation, deletion, modification, or specific trading segment activation.
Complaints about the ease of use, design, or functionality of specific app features like charts or trading tools.
This theme covers concerns about the relevance, accuracy, or trustworthiness of investment suggestions and data provided by the platform.
This theme covers concerns about the accuracy, reliability, or manipulation of data displayed within the application, impacting user trust and trading decisions.
Covers broad statements of satisfaction or dissatisfaction without specific details, or general comments about the platform experience.
Concerns related to the safety and security of user funds, personal data, and overall platform trustworthiness.
Issues related to the app's user interface, ease of navigation, and overall user experience.
Feedback related to the app's design, ease of use, available features, and informative content.
Broad positive comments about the application without specific details or feature mentions.
This theme covers reviews expressing a lack of trust in the app's reliability, security, or overall integrity.
This theme covers complaints about features that are absent from the application or platform, limiting user functionality.
